units: Framework for adaptive intelligence through autonomous representation expansion under environmental pressure.
REE asks whether persistent predictive failure can trigger autonomous discovery and expansion of an agent's internal representation.
REE models intelligence as detecting representational insufficiency, discovering missing structure, and modifying the computational substrate.
environment -> prediction -> error pressure -> representation stress -> hypothesis discovery -> representation expansion -> improved prediction.
Parameter optimization adjusts an existing representation; REE is proposed to modify the representation itself.
Torsion signal is described as representational pressure derived from prediction failure.
Persistent error beyond a threshold is interpreted as evidence that the current representation is insufficient.
Candidate structural expansions are generated after pressure detection.
Example current representation [v, context] faces environment change from y=2v to y=v*context.
Candidate expansion labels are null, augment, and interaction.
Candidate representations are evaluated against residual error and the representation that best explains the new structure is selected.
Structural memory preserves a committed useful expansion to prevent repeated rediscovery and mutation loops.
Validation environment has Phase 1 y=2v followed by Phase 2 y=v*context.
Source reports that REE detected the structural shift.
Source reports generation of interaction hypotheses after the shift.
Source reports selection of the correct expansion.
Source reports representation size increased and performance was restored.
Seed 42: post-shift MSE 0.04105, representation size 3, mutations 1.
Seed 123: post-shift MSE 0.04234, representation size 3, mutations 1.
Seed 789: post-shift MSE 0.04309, representation size 3, mutations 1.
Source reports representation changed from [v, context] to [v, context, v*context] without manual intervention.
If representation is the limiting factor, intelligence may require mechanisms that change the space in which learning occurs.
REE is described as a research prototype.
Current focus: validating expansion mechanisms, environmental phase transitions, adaptation thresholds, and links among representation, compression, and causal discovery.
README describes implementation paths agent.py, environment.py, hypotheses.py, tracker.py, evaluator.py and experiments/phase_transition.py.
REE investigates converting environmental pressure into discovery, representation expansion, and increased adaptability.
README does not define the torsion formula, threshold value, aggregation window, or decision protocol.
Residual-error fitness function, evaluation window, tie handling, and candidate complexity penalty are not specified.
README gives result numbers but no dataset generation, noise model, sample count, training procedure, or MSE evaluation window.
All implementation paths named by README are absent from the frozen current-head tree and no visible commit in the six-commit history adds them.
No persisted run log, model checkpoint, result file, executable instrument, or test artifact in the frozen repository independently reconstructs the reported validation.
The source calls hypothesis generation and expansion autonomous, but the boundary between predefined candidate family and autonomous structural discovery is not operationalized.
The criterion for 'correct expansion' and ground-truth representation identity is not specified beyond the constructed multiplicative environment.
REE studies adaptive systems modifying internal representations when current representations become insufficient.
Agents operate through compressed internal models rather than optimizing reality directly.
Names Representation Quality, Information Bottleneck, Minimum Description Length, and Epiplexity as related work.
A fixed representation creates residual mismatch; prediction error, torsion, and transfer degradation are proposed indicators.
Error is framed not only as optimization failure but as possible evidence of an incomplete representation.
Torsion is described as accumulated structural strain indicating approach to a representational boundary.
Names computational phase boundaries, resolution horizon, and constraint permeability as related concepts.
When pressure exceeds tolerance, the system searches for new features, interactions, and causal structure.
Names hypothesis generation, causal discovery, and program synthesis as related concepts.
Source states Interface-Induced Computational Geometry is connected because changing reachable computation space changes capability.
Named endpoint is not resolved to a Cerebro node.
A better representation is asserted to increase predictive accuracy, adaptive viability, and future reachable states.
Names Causal Mass, Causal Velocity, and Computational Leverage as related concepts.
Source names CTRE Simulator as a project for experimental validation of recursive representation expansion.
CTRE Simulator is source-described as a validated prototype.
Source says CTRE demonstrates environment shift -> pressure -> discovery -> expansion -> stabilization.
REE is source-described as a mechanism for changing computational geometry available to an agent.
Source states the environment transition creates a phase boundary where the old representation becomes insufficient.
Source states expansion occurs when the current information/computation horizon cannot resolve the environment.
Source states REE requires self-constraint modification; closed optimizers cannot expand whereas permeable optimizers can.
Source states successful representation expansion increases causal footprint by enabling influence over future trajectories.
Reality -> Representation -> mismatch -> torsion pressure -> Discovery -> Representation expansion -> New computational capability -> Increased causal influence.
Prediction error is not uniquely diagnostic of representation insufficiency; optimizer, data, noise, nonstationarity, or model-fit failures are not discriminated.
Torsion and pressure lack a measurement definition in this file.
Pressure tolerance and discovery-trigger criteria are not operationalized.
Causal capacity, causal footprint, adaptive viability, and reachable-state increase are not measured or causally identified.
Named project/concept endpoints are not tied to immutable repository identities in this source and therefore emit no Cerebro map edges.
The 'validated prototype' status is a source-authored assertion about an external named project; its evidential basis is not contained in R24's frozen source.
Named related-work concepts are not bibliographically cited or disambiguated in this file.
